get_organisation.description: Look up a UK funder or grant recipient by its 360Giving id, charity or company number, or GrantNav link: its name, other ids, and how many grants it has made and received, how much they came to and over which years.

mock_response.name: The Blagrave Trust
mock_response.summary: The Blagrave Trust (GB-CHC-1164021) has made 627 grants worth £25,366,160.98 (7 July 2013 to 27 April 2026) and received 20 grants worth £2,443,250 (9 August 2016 to 18 September 2025). It publishes its own grants data.

description: Look up the grants UK funders publish through 360Giving: get a charity, company or other organisation by its id or charity number with the totals of the grants it has made and received, list those grants newest first or by award date, and run a workflow when a new one is published. No account or API key required.

threesixtygiving_new_grant_trigger.description: Triggers once for each grant newly published as made or received by the organisation you choose. 360Giving updates its data once a day, overnight UK time, and funders often publish months after a grant is awarded. Grants already published when you turn it on never trigger it. Works for organisations with up to 5,000 grants made or received.

parameters.description: Grants the organisation made as a funder (the default), or grants it received.
